gratitudeExpress.title: Express gratitude
gratitudeExpress.description: Write 3 things you are grateful for today

mindfulWalk.title: Mindful walk
mindfulWalk.description: Walk for 5 minutes paying attention to each step
mindfulWalk.step1: Go to a quiet space. If you cannot go outside, walk slowly around your home.
mindfulWalk.step2: With each step, feel the ground beneath your feet. Notice your body weight.
mindfulWalk.step3: Observe 3 things around you. A color, a sound, a texture.

digitalDetox.title: Digital detox
digitalDetox.description: Spend 15 minutes without looking at your phone
digitalDetox.step1: Put your phone on airplane mode or face-down in another room.
digitalDetox.step2: Choose a screen-free activity: reading, drawing, walking, cooking.
digitalDetox.step3: When finished, notice how you feel. More calm? More energized?

quickDiary.title: Quick diary
quickDiary.description: Write 3 sentences about how you feel right now

bodyScan.title: Body scan
bodyScan.description: Scan your body from head to toe noticing tension
bodyScan.step1: Close your eyes. Bring attention to your feet. Is there tension or warmth?
bodyScan.step2: Move up slowly: legs, abdomen, chest. Breathe deeply into each area.
bodyScan.step3: Continue to shoulders, neck and face. Release any tension you notice.
bodyScan.step4: Finish with 3 deep breaths. Open your eyes slowly.

actOfKindness.title: Act of kindness
actOfKindness.description: Do something kind for someone today without expecting anything
actOfKindness.step1: Think of someone close: family, friend, colleague, or even a stranger.
actOfKindness.step2: Choose a small but genuine act: a message, a helping hand, a smile.
actOfKindness.step3: Do it without expecting anything in return. The value is in giving, not receiving.

stretching.title: Stretching
stretching.description: Stretch your body for 5 minutes when you wake up
stretching.step1: Standing or sitting, stretch your arms overhead. Hold for 10 seconds.
stretching.step2: Gently tilt your head to each side. Feel the stretch in your neck.
stretching.step3: Stretch your legs: reach for your feet or extend one leg at a time.

shortMeditation.title: Short meditation
shortMeditation.description: Sit in silence and observe your thoughts
shortMeditation.step1: Sit comfortably. Close your eyes. Take 3 deep breaths.
shortMeditation.step2: Observe your thoughts without judging them. They are clouds passing by.
shortMeditation.step3: When your mind wanders, gently bring it back to your breathing.

healingMusic.title: Healing music
healingMusic.description: Listen mindfully to a song that makes you happy
healingMusic.step1: Play a song you love or that calms you. Use headphones if you can.
healingMusic.step2: Close your eyes and listen closely: the melody, the rhythm, the lyrics.

positiveAffirmation.title: Positive affirmation
positiveAffirmation.description: Repeat 3 times: "I deserve peace and happiness"
positiveAffirmation.step1: Stand in front of a mirror or sit with your eyes closed.
positiveAffirmation.step2: Take a deep breath and say aloud: "I deserve peace and happiness".
positiveAffirmation.step3: Repeat it 3 more times. With each time, feel yourself believing it more deeply.

observeNature.title: Observe nature
observeNature.description: Go outside and observe something natural for 3 minutes
observeNature.step1: Step outside or go to a window. Choose a natural element: tree, sky, plant.
observeNature.step2: Observe it in silence for 3 minutes. Notice its colors, movement, and textures.

silentForgiveness.title: Silent forgiveness
silentForgiveness.description: Think about something bothering you and practice letting it go
silentForgiveness.step1: Think of something or someone that has upset you. Do not judge it, just observe.
silentForgiveness.step2: Breathe deeply and say internally: "I release you. I release myself".
silentForgiveness.step3: Remember: forgiving is not approving. It is releasing the weight so it does not hurt you.

limitComplaints.title: Limit complaints
limitComplaints.description: Try to spend 2 hours without complaining about anything
limitComplaints.step1: For the next 2 hours, every time you want to complain, pause.
limitComplaints.step2: Ask yourself: Can I do something about this? If yes, act. If no, let it go.
limitComplaints.step3: When done, write 1 positive thing you noticed during the challenge.

0.text: Peace comes from within. Do not seek it outside.
0.author: Buda

1.text: You do not have to control everything. Sometimes you only need to let go.
1.author: Lumen

2.text: Every day is a new opportunity to be kinder to yourself.
2.author: Lumen

3.text: Vulnerability is not weakness. It is the greatest measure of courage.
3.author: Brené Brown

4.text: Your mind is a garden. Your thoughts are the seeds.
4.author: Lumen

5.text: It is not the load that breaks you down, it is how you carry it.
5.author: Lou Holtz

6.text: Breathe. You are exactly where you need to be.
6.author: Lumen

7.text: Today you deserve your own kindness as much as anyone else does.
7.author: Lumen

8.text: Self-care is not selfish. You cannot serve from an empty cup.
8.author: Eleanor Brownn

9.text: Emotions are like waves. Watch them come and go.
9.author: Lumen

10.text: One small step today is a giant leap for your wellbeing.
10.author: Lumen

11.text: You do not have to be perfect to deserve love and acceptance.
11.author: Lumen

12.text: Gratitude turns what you have into enough.
12.author: Melody Beattie

13.text: Your worth does not decrease because someone cannot see your light.
13.author: Lumen

14.text: It is okay not to be okay. What matters is not staying there.
14.author: Lumen

15.text: Calm is a superpower in a world full of noise.
15.author: Lumen

16.text: Do not compare your chapter 1 to someone else's chapter 20.
16.author: Lumen

17.text: Be patient with yourself. Growth takes time.
17.author: Lumen

18.text: The best relationship you can have is the one you have with yourself.
18.author: Diane Von Furstenberg

19.text: Choose compassion today. Start with yourself.
19.author: Lumen

20.text: Rest is not giving up. It is getting ready to continue.
20.author: Lumen

21.text: You do not need a reason to deserve inner peace.
21.author: Lumen

22.text: Every breath is a chance to begin again.
22.author: Lumen

23.text: Your mental health is a priority, not a luxury.
23.author: Lumen

24.text: Today's small victories are tomorrow's great achievements.
24.author: Lumen

25.text: Allow yourself to feel. Emotions are not your enemy.
25.author: Lumen

26.text: What nourishes your soul is never a waste of time.
26.author: Lumen

27.text: You are not your thoughts. You are the one who observes them.
27.author: Eckhart Tolle

28.text: Today is a good day to take care of yourself.
28.author: Lumen

29.text: True strength appears in moments of vulnerability.
29.author: Lumen

30.text: Your journey matters. Every step counts.
30.author: Lumen

31.text: Happiness is not the absence of problems, but the ability to deal with them.
31.author: Steve Maraboli

lumi.name: Lumi
lumi.intro: Hi, {name}! I’m Lumi, a little light who’ll keep you company here. Tap me whenever you want to chat.
lumi.night: It’s late, {name}… a short breathing session before bed? Resting is self-care too.
lumi.welcomeBack: {name}, I missed you! The streak isn’t what matters: you came back.
lumi.askMoodMorning: Good morning, {name}! How did you wake up today?
lumi.askMood: Hi, {name}! How are you feeling today? Tell me down below.
lumi.hardDay: Thanks for telling me, {name}. You can take it slow today; I’m right here with you.
lumi.commitment: Hey… yesterday you picked a challenge. How did it go? I’m curious!
lumi.streak: {n} days in a row taking care of yourself! I’m so proud to be with you.
lumi.nextLesson: Shall we do "{lesson}"? I think you’ll like it.
lumi.review: You did your lesson. A quick review so it sticks?
lumi.allDone: You did so much for yourself today, {name}! I’m glowing with joy.
lumi.goodMood: So glad you feel this way today, {name}! Let’s treasure this moment.
lumi.default: I’m here, {name}. One step at a time.

tap.0: Did you know naming an emotion can lower its intensity?
tap.1: Hehe, that tickles! Okay, back to taking care of you.
tap.2: Have you had some water today? Your brain needs it too.
tap.3: Breathe with me: in… and slowly out. That’s it, nicely done.
tap.4: Every small step counts. Really, every single one.
tap.5: If today feels heavy, it’s okay to go slower. I’m still here.
tap.6: I love it when you come by. I glow brighter!
tap.7: Have you given yourself permission to rest today?
tap.8: Your emotions aren’t good or bad: they’re information.
tap.9: One thing to be grateful for today, even a tiny one. What would it be?
tap.10: Remember: asking for help takes courage too.
tap.11: I’m a small light, but next to you I feel huge.

support.title: Support Lumen
support.menuSubtitle: How to help it keep growing
support.madeByBody: Lumen is made by Ángel, one person, in his free time. Every lesson, drawing, sound and even Lumi are handmade, with one simple idea: looking after your mind should not cost money or feel like a chore.
support.point1: Keeps Lumen free for people who cannot pay.
support.point2: New lessons and content, written slowly and carefully.
support.point3: Keeps crisis help one tap away and always free.
support.point4: Makes room for more projects like this one, made to help people.
support.shareBody: Maybe someone you love needs it today.
support.shareText: I am using Lumen, an app to look after your mind a few minutes a day: lessons, a journal, breathing and a garden that grows with you 🌱
support.rateBody: An honest review helps more people find it.
support.ideaBody: What you would like Lumen to do, or what is not working.
support.soonBody: Soon you will be able to give Lumi hats, scarves and colours. They will be cosmetic only, to support the project if you want to and can.
support.promise: A promise: wellbeing content and crisis help will always be free. We will never charge you for taking care of yourself.
support.thanks:
Thank you for being here.
It really helps 🤍
